chunks: And with this chain of transmission, from ʿAlī عليه السلام, he said:
The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said: “Waiting for salat (prayer) after salat (prayer) is a treasure from the treasures of Paradise.”

key_terms.الْجَنَّةِ: Paradise, the abode of divine reward

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for waiting for the next salat (prayer) after finishing a salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith praises remaining in a state of readiness and longing for the next salat (prayer) after completing one salat (prayer). It presents such devotion as a great spiritual reward, describing it as one of the treasures of Paradise.
